headline: Executive order signed in February 2025 that begins shrinking parts of the federal government.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order starts an effort to reduce the size of the federal bureaucracy. No official summary was provided, so the specific agencies, programs, or steps involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Workers at affected federal offices could see changes to their jobs if those offices are reduced.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups who use services from affected federal offices
who_it_affects.how: Services or grants from offices that are reduced could be cut back or changed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 19, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available material.
